<div class="card-body">
'''Lightsaber Deficiency''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ライトセーバーに不馴れ</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：「ライトセーバー修得」をキャンセルする。2：ライトセーバーを戦闘かフォース消耗に使用している能力値＜4のキャラクターを目標とする。運命数を引く。運命数＞能力値なら目標はロストする。運命数＝能力値ならライトセーバーがロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Lightsaber-Deficiency-PSA-86099791.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「うう……くそっ……」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Lightsaber Deficiency.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: Cancel Lightsaber Proficiency.

2: Target a character of ability less than 4 using a lightsaber in battle or a Force drain. Draw destiny. The target is lost if destiny exceeds ability. The lightsaber is lost if destiny equals ability.

'''Lore:'''
Ugh... damn...

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Title uses 不馴れ.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Lightsaber Deficiency]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
